description: Builds a Channex booking-page URL the guest opens themselves. Does not create a booking and does not accept payment card data. Dates, guests and currency prefill on the booking page.

check_in.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in Pacific/Auckland.

check_out.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check-in. Maximum 30 nights.

children.description: Number of children aged 1 or over, from 0 to 20. Do not count infants under 1 here.

infants.description: Infants under 1 year. They do not count toward occupancy. One cot is available to hire.

room_type.description: Optional room type title or id. Copied into the roomType parameter, which is not confirmed to filter the booking page.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get booking link
